To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

environmental health is the result of the adaptive processes of social–ecological system and that the environment and society must be considered systems, not matrices of factors, in order to study and solve environmental health problems.
sustainability science could be a good approach for studying environmental health problems.
sustainability science contributes to the study of problems of environmental health by providing a new perspective, a different unit of analysis and a different approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what sustainability science could contribute in order to improve studies of environmental health problems, and how.
the contribution of sustainability science to environmental health problems and the need to integrate sustainability science with environmental health studies.
the question of whether the study of environmental problems can be improved by adopting the sustainability science approach.   1
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
environmental health problems are not resolved by environmental health studies, but by sustainability science studies.
environmental health problems are social–ecological adaptation processes that can be explained by the interaction of the environment and society as systems, not matrices of factors.

sustainability science is a new paradigm that can be useful for the study of environmental problems and that, in the specific case of environmental health, can contribute to solve some of the problems that are being ignored.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sustainability science could help to understand environmental health problems as social–ecology systems that are resilient, and that are affected and modified by human action.   1.
sustainability science is a useful approach to study environmental health problems.

sustainability science could be a new paradigm that contributes to the study of the causes of environmental health problems and to the design and implementation of policies that improve environmental health conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the study of environmental problems from a sustainability perspective could be useful for understanding the behaviour of these problems, and, in turn for designing and implementing policies that can solve them.
the study of environmental problems from a social–ecological system perspective could be a good way to understand them and to find solutions to resolve them.
the study of environmental problems should be done through the lens of sustainability science.
